entities.description: A baby with short black hair and an open-mouthed expression lies on its back, wearing a light gray short-sleeved onesie with faint white patterns and white socks. An adult's hand rests gently on the baby's abdomen, while the baby's right arm is raised with a loosely clenched fist.

attributes.pose: lying on back, one arm raised

entities.description: A woman with dark skin and curly black hair lies on her side on a light-colored surface, wearing a light blue long-sleeved shirt and black pants, with her eyes closed and a calm expression. She is holding a baby dressed in a white onesie with thin gray stripes, who is lying on their back with one arm raised and mouth open.

A light beige or off-white sofa with a smooth, possibly microfiber or suede-like fabric texture. The visible portion shows a large, cushioned backrest and seat section with a clean, modern design. The seams are neatly stitched, and the material appears soft and slightly plush. The sofa is positioned horizontally in the frame, serving as the surface on which a woman and infant are lying.

attributes.material: smooth fabric, likely microfiber or suede-like
